notes.title: BIG UPDATE PUBLISH DATE
notes.content:
[b]BIG UPDATE PUBLISH DATE[/b]

The big game update I've been working on has been going smoothly.

The planned release date of the update is in a week (20th July). If everything goes as planned the update will be released even sooner but If some complications occur the update will be delayed but not for long and I will notify everyone.

The whole gameplay experience will be different from the previous one and If you enjoyed the game at least a little bit till now, you will NOT be disappointed by this update. Stay tuned!

notes.title: UPDATES AND PLANS
notes.content:
[b]UPDATES AND PLANS[/b]

Since the release of the game I've been working to improve on the concept and to get the game moving in a better direction with the feedbacks and reviews it received.

I made some changes and added a few things and plan to expand on the game heavily and as soon as possible.

I will list below the few new things done so far and some things that I plan to implement and make, but not all. I will not spoil every detail to keep it slightly interesting.

- There is now a system voice that triggers on some event like when danger is approaching, when the rover has a cooling error, when a reboot is done and etc.

- There is now a system terminal as you can see below on the bottom right of the picture that will be used to get more information regarding the world lore and what happened prior to the incident.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056324/9d94729f7716ea22b2e17b7f7cb97f4578442897.png[/img]

- The rover will have a scan function on certain objects/entities that will be used with the new system terminal to dig out the information.

- Improve on the world design and detail to make it more lore rich and more unsettling

- There will be random happenings and events such as sand storms, unexplained shockwaves and more

- There will be more hidden locations to explore

- More ambiances to make the experience more immersive

- Rework of the ending with a big possibility for multiple endings

- And more things that I will not tell so you can see for yourself

The game will have bugfixes as soon as they are discovered, but regarding the updates I plan to finish all the things listed above so I can put out a mega update that nearly changes the whole game. 

I will do my best that the update will be released as soon as possible so stay tuned.

notes.title: Updates and tweaks
notes.content:
[b]Updates and tweaks regarding some bugs and changes since release.[/b]

- Fixed rover movement sfx when pressing the same directional button twice

- Slight audio adjustments

- Delayed creature encounter

- On collision or getting very close to rocks and walls the rover will bump and or stop movement instead of still trying to move in that direction

- New unique models for every key location
